issues.span: 脫離眾生受苦的地方
issues.evidence: The text says only "desire to be free from the state/place of beings"; "suffering" is not stated.
issues.fix: 想要脫離眾生所在的地方，就要好好守護這顆珍貴的覺悟之心。

issues.evidence: The giving of food and drink is continuous ("持續供應飲食"); the children's text drops the continuous provision and only says "a little food".
issues.fix: 如果有人一直給少數眾生一點飲食，卻只在短短的時間裡給一頓飯，還帶著輕視，只讓人飽上半天，世人還是會尊敬他做了好事。

issues.span: 如果有人只給少數眾生一點食物。他只花短短的時間給一頓飯。就算他帶著輕視
issues.evidence: The conditional is broken into separate sentences by full stops, leaving "如果...。" and "就算..." ungrammatical.
issues.fix: 如果有人給少數眾生一點食物，只花短短的時間給一頓飯，還帶著輕視，只讓人飽上半天，世人還是會尊敬他做了好事。

issues.span: 想要獲得累積的福氣的智慧
issues.evidence: The Tibetan/academic text speaks of the wisdom/intelligence that cultivates merit ("修福德之慧"), not wanting to obtain it; wording is also tangled.
issues.fix: 世界上想要去累積福氣的智慧，在一百次裡偶爾才會出現一次。

issues.span: 就隨便他們對我做吧 / 只要有人遇到我、想到我
issues.evidence: Academic: "whatever action does not harm them, let them do it; in relation to me, may none be in vain". "Do to me" and "meet me, think of me / get benefit" are not stated.
issues.fix: 只要是不會傷害到他們自己的事，就讓他們去做吧。希望不管在什麼時候，只要和我有關，就不會有人白費力氣。

issues.span: 如果嚴重的墮落，和強大的覺悟之心，在輪迴中交替出現。我就要花很久
issues.evidence: The "if" clause is cut off by a full stop from its main clause, which is ungrammatical.
issues.fix: 如果嚴重的墮落，和強大的覺悟之心，在輪迴中交替出現，我就要花很久的時間，才能走到菩薩修行的更高階段。

issues.span: 因為敬畏而心生恭敬
issues.evidence: Academic: respect arises "out of fear" (畏懼); "敬畏" (awe/reverence) shifts the sense.
issues.fix: 如果有緣的人因為心裡害怕而生起恭敬，仔細留意就能很輕鬆地生起。

issues.span: 當我聽到各種無聊的話語，或是看到許多新奇的景象。如果我參與其中
issues.evidence: The "when" clause is split from its main clause by a full stop; "聽到/看到" then "參與其中" is redundant and ungrammatical.
issues.fix: 當我參與各種無聊的話語，或是許多新奇的景象時，要放下對它們的緊抓不放。

issues.span: 下輩子更會帶來巨大的痛苦
issues.evidence: Academic: "in the next life there is also great suffering" (亦有大苦); "更" (even more) adds a comparison that is not there.
issues.fix: 下輩子也會帶來巨大的痛苦。

issues.evidence: Academic says the action is prompted "always" (恆) by strong intention; the children's text drops "always".
issues.fix: 如果是一直帶著強烈的心意去做，或是靠解藥的力量去做。

issues.span: 隔天一早就要馬上起床
issues.evidence: Academic: set firmly in the mind from the start the intention of rising quickly; "next morning" and "before sleep" timing are not stated.
issues.fix: 要保持警覺，一開始就在心裡下定決心：要趕快起床。

issues.span: 毒蛇和飛蟲
issues.evidence: Tibetan sha sbrang / academic 牛虻 = gadfly/horsefly (a biting fly); "飛蟲" is vague and drops that it bites.
issues.fix: 毒蛇和會咬人的大牛蠅

issues.span: 不就更不用說了嗎
issues.evidence: Academic: 何須多言, i.e. the hell sufferings are obviously far worse and need no mention; the double-negative question is tangled for ages 8-12.
issues.fix: 那就更不用多說了。

issues.span: 也不討厭輪迴的痛苦
issues.evidence: Academic: 不厭患輪迴之苦, i.e. not becoming weary/fed up with samsaric suffering; "不討厭" can read as simply not disliking it, which muddles the logic.
issues.fix: 也不覺得輪迴的痛苦令人厭煩

issues.span: 接近有幫助的條件
issues.evidence: Academic: 應尋求親近 (the object of "meeting" is left unspecified); "有幫助的條件" supplies an object not in the text.
issues.fix: 我應該去親近（合適的人或事），或是去做適合的事。

issues.span: 沒有美好的品質又怎樣呢？
issues.evidence: Academic: 無功德復有何用, i.e. having no qualities is of no use; "又怎樣呢" reads as a dismissive "so what", which can reverse the sense.
issues.fix: 沒有美好的品質有什麼用呢？其實我們都有美好的品質。

issues.span: （爸爸媽媽）
issues.evidence: Academic says only 他人之精血相合之滴聚; the identification of "others" as parents is added in brackets.
issues.fix: 就像你對別人給的那一小滴生命來源，產生認為有個我的想法一樣。

issues.span: 就像你對別人（爸爸媽媽）給的那一小滴生命來源，產生認為有個我的想法一樣。
issues.evidence: Sentence is a dangling "just as..." clause with no main clause; the logical link 是故 (therefore) is lost.
issues.fix: 就像你對別人給的那一小滴生命來源，產生了「有個我」的想法；所以現在，你也要練習對別人這樣想。

issues.span: 身體變得這麼嬌弱以後
issues.evidence: Academic: 即使已如是墮入此境 (having fallen into this state); neither the Tibetan nor the academic text mentions a body or its being delicate/weak.
issues.fix: 就算已經落到這樣的境地，如果連整片大地都無法滿足他的欲望，還有誰能滿足他呢？

issues.span: 如果別人沒有得到的財物
issues.evidence: Academic: 有情貶低無利養之人; "沒有得到的財物" is ungrammatical use of the locked term (should be "沒有得到財物的人").
issues.fix: 如果有人沒有得到財物，眾生就會看不起他們；如果有人得到了財物，眾生又會說難聽的話。

issues.span: 想去追求別人
issues.evidence: Tibetan/academic: being an impure bag, he greedily craves (desires) others, i.e. others' impure bodies; "追求別人" reads as courting people and loses that the object is impure.
issues.fix: 你不但不討厭自己身上的骯髒，你自己明明就是一個裝滿髒東西的袋子，卻還因為貪心，去渴望別人那些骯髒的身體。

issues.span: 感受不會體驗它自己
issues.evidence: Source: "self does not experience self" (the awareness does not experience itself); "感受" (feeling) is a different thing and changes the subject from the mind mentioned just before.
issues.fix: 覺知不會體驗它自己，其他的東西也不會體驗它。

issues.span: 心不是身體
issues.evidence: Academic translation has no subject ("何者非身非他處"); the children's text supplies "心" as the thing in question, which this segment does not state.
issues.fix: 它不是身體，也不在別的地方。它不和身體混合，也沒有單獨存在。它連一點點真實的東西都沒有，所以眾生的本性早已經脫離憂苦了。

issues.span: 如果神不依靠其他事物，他為什麼不一直創造東西呢
issues.evidence: Academic translation says only "彼" (that one), without naming a god; "神" is supplied from context.
issues.fix: 如果他不依靠其他事物，他為什麼不一直創造東西呢？

issues.span: 我回答：「
issues.evidence: No speaker marker in the Tibetan or academic translation; "我回答" adds a speaker/dialogue frame.
issues.fix: 如果不先接觸想像出來的東西，就不會發現這是不存在的東西。因此，如果一件事物是假的，那麼說它是「不存在的東西」，明顯也是假的。

issues.span: 因為各種爭吵和開心的事情
issues.evidence: Source: "by the causes of fighting and joy"; the word "causes" is dropped, so the point that these are the causes is lost.
issues.fix: 因為各種會帶來爭吵和開心的原因，

issues.span: 許多人
issues.evidence: Tibetan "འགའ་ཞིག" / academic "有人" = some one; number changed to "許多人".
issues.fix: 有人明明活在巨大的痛苦中，卻還以為自己很快樂。

issues.span: 最後連這根深的習慣也會被消除
issues.evidence: Source: by habituating "nothing exists", that (the habit of emptiness) will in turn be abandoned; "這根深的習慣" is ambiguous and could be read as the habit of things.
issues.fix: 最後連空性的根深習慣也會被消除。

issues.span: 有人可能會說：
issues.evidence: Academic translation states directly that one person is imputed as father and son; it does not mark this as an imagined objection.
issues.fix: 同一個人可以被叫做父親，也可以被叫做兒子。可是這只是被貼上名稱，並不是真實的樣子。

issues.span: 印度的為我授戒的老師薩婆若提婆
issues.evidence: Academic: "印度親教師薩婆若提婆"; the stacked modifiers are tangled for ages 8-12.
issues.fix: 印度的薩婆若提婆，是為我授戒的老師，他和主要校訂的翻譯家班第吉祥積，根據喀什米爾的書本，一起檢查並確定了文字。
